title: Service Infrastructure Metrics
description: CPU, memory, network, disk I/O, requests, limits and volumes of the pods in the team's rg namespace, federated by the team collector from the platform Prometheus (cadvisor, kubelet, kube-state-metrics).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pod AS Pod,
  anyIf(v, m = 'cpu') AS CPU,
  anyIf(v, m = 'cpu_request') AS `CPU request`,
  anyIf(v, m = 'cpu_limit') AS `CPU limit`,
  anyIf(v, m = 'memory') AS `Memory (working set)`,
  anyIf(v, m = 'memory_request') AS `Memory request`,
  anyIf(v, m = 'memory_limit') AS `Memory limit`,
  max(at) AS `Last seen`
FROM (
  -- cpu: average rate over the window, summed over the containers
  SELECT pod, 'cpu' AS m, sum(r) AS v, max(at) AS at
  FROM (
    SELECT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS container,
           (max(Value) - min(Value)) / nullIf(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)), 0) AS r,
           max(TimeUnix) AS at
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
      AND MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total' AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor' AND Attributes['image'] != '' AND Attributes['container'] NOT IN ('', 'POD')
    GROUP BY pod, container
  )
  GROUP BY pod
  UNION ALL
  -- memory: latest scrape, summed over the containers
  SELECT pod, 'memory' AS m, sum(v) AS v, max(at) AS at
  FROM (
    SELECT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS container,
           argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v, max(TimeUnix) AS at
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
      AND MetricName = 'container_memory_working_set_bytes' AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor' AND Attributes['image'] != '' AND Attributes['container'] NOT IN ('', 'POD')
    GROUP BY pod, container
  )
  GROUP BY pod
  UNION ALL
  -- requests and limits (kube-state-metrics), summed over the containers
  SELECT pod, concat(Attributes_resource, '_', kind) AS m, sum(v) AS v, max(at) AS at
  FROM (
    SELECT Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['container'] AS container, Attributes['resource'] AS Attributes_resource,
           if(MetricName = 'kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'request', 'limit') AS kind,
           argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v, max(TimeUnix) AS at
    FROM otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
      AND MetricName IN ('kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'kube_pod_container_resource_limits')
      AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory')
    GROUP BY pod, container, Attributes_resource, kind
  )
  GROUP BY pod, m
)
GROUP BY pod
ORDER BY pod

SELECT time, series, sum(r) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time, series, key, avg(rate) AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT t, series, key,
           (v - lagInFrame(v) OVER w)
             / nullIf(dateDiff('millisecond', lagInFrame(t) OVER w, t) / 1000, 0) AS rate,
           row_number() OVER w AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT TimeUnix AS t, Value AS v, Attributes['pod'] AS series, concat(Attributes['pod'], '/', Attributes['container']) AS key
      FROM otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total'
        AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor' AND Attributes['image'] != '' AND Attributes['container'] NOT IN ('', 'POD') AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
    )
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY t
                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
  )
  -- first sample has no predecessor; negative rate = counter reset
  WHERE rn > 1 AND rate >= 0
  GROUP BY time, series, key
)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time, series, avg(v) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT TimeUnix AS t, Attributes['pod'] AS series, sum(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND MetricName = 'container_memory_working_set_bytes'
    AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor' AND Attributes['image'] != '' AND Attributes['container'] NOT IN ('', 'POD') AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
  GROUP BY t, series
)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(r) AS value
FROM (
  -- network is reported per pod, once per interface; the max over the
  -- container label keeps a pod's traffic from being counted twice
  SELECT time, series, iface, max(r) AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time, series, iface, key, avg(rate) AS r
    FROM (
      SELECT t, series, iface, key,
             (v - lagInFrame(v) OVER w)
               / nullIf(dateDiff('millisecond', lagInFrame(t) OVER w, t) / 1000, 0) AS rate,
             row_number() OVER w AS rn
      FROM (
        SELECT TimeUnix AS t, Value AS v,
               concat(Attributes['pod'], ' ', if(MetricName LIKE '%receive%', 'receive', 'transmit')) AS series,
               Attributes['interface'] AS iface,
               concat(MetricName, '/', Attributes['pod'], '/', Attributes['container'], '/', Attributes['interface']) AS key
        FROM otel_metrics_gauge
        WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor'
          AND MetricName IN ('container_network_receive_bytes_total', 'container_network_transmit_bytes_total')
          AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
      )
      WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY t
                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
    WHERE rn > 1 AND rate >= 0
    GROUP BY time, series, iface, key
  )
  GROUP BY time, series, iface
)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(r) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time, series, key, avg(rate) AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT t, series, key,
           (v - lagInFrame(v) OVER w)
             / nullIf(dateDiff('millisecond', lagInFrame(t) OVER w, t) / 1000, 0) AS rate,

    FROM (
      SELECT TimeUnix AS t, Value AS v,
             concat(Attributes['pod'], ' ', if(MetricName LIKE '%reads%', 'read', 'write')) AS series,
             concat(MetricName, '/', Attributes['pod'], '/', Attributes['container'], '/', Attributes['device']) AS key
      FROM otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%'
        AND MetricName IN ('container_fs_reads_bytes_total', 'container_fs_writes_bytes_total')
        AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor' AND Attributes['image'] != '' AND Attributes['container'] NOT IN ('', 'POD') AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
    )
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY t
                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
  )
  -- first sample has no predecessor; negative rate = counter reset
  WHERE rn > 1 AND rate >= 0
  GROUP BY time, series, key
)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time, series, avg(v) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT TimeUnix AS t, concat(Attributes['pod'], '/', Attributes['container']) AS series, sum(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%' AND MetricName = 'container_memory_working_set_bytes'
    AND Attributes['metrics_path'] = '/metrics/cadvisor' AND Attributes['image'] != '' AND Attributes['container'] NOT IN ('', 'POD') AND Attributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
  GROUP BY t, series
)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  claim AS Volume,
  anyIf(v, MetricName = 'kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes') AS Capacity,
  anyIf(v, MetricName = 'kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes') AS Used,
  Used / nullIf(Capacity, 0) AS `Used %`
FROM (
  -- the volume series carry the claim but no pod
  SELECT Attributes['persistentvolumeclaim'] AS claim, MetricName, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ScopeName LIKE '%prometheusreceiver%'
    AND MetricName IN ('kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes', 'kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes')
  GROUP BY claim, MetricName
)
GROUP BY claim
ORDER BY `Used %` DESC
